mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past four months indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with sustained HOUST increase, or HOUST increase does not correlate with economic strengthening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased corporate costs.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances with joint increase in RSAFS and PAYEMS, or the joint increase does not correlate with strengthening demand and labor market.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% over the past quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past four months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decrease does not correlate with broader economic slowdown.
